panels.title: Consommation journalière par couleur Tempo
panels.description: Valeur journalière Enedis (0h-24h) colorée selon le jour Tempo de la même date.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  c.date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS time,
  SUM(c.value) FILTER (WHERE t.color = 'BLUE') / 1000.0 AS "Bleu",
  SUM(c.value) FILTER (WHERE t.color = 'WHITE') / 1000.0 AS "Blanc",
  SUM(c.value) FILTER (WHERE t.color = 'RED') / 1000.0 AS "Rouge",
  SUM(c.value) FILTER (WHERE t.color IS NULL) / 1000.0 AS "Inconnu"
FROM consumption_data c
LEFT JOIN tempo_days t ON t.id = c.date::text
WHERE c.granularity = 'daily' AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Courbe de charge (puissance moyenne par demi-heure)
panels.description: Données Enedis au pas de 30 minutes, en W moyens. Astuce : réduis la période affichée (7 ou 30 jours) pour plus de lisibilité.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (date + interval_start::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS time,
  value AS "Puissance moyenne"
FROM consumption_data
WHERE granularity = 'detailed' AND date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
ORDER BY 1

options.content:
### Tempo

- Saison du 1er septembre au 31 août : **22 jours rouges**, **43 jours blancs**, le reste en bleu.
- Un jour Tempo va de **6h à 6h** le lendemain.
- Heures creuses : **22h à 6h**.

### Calculs

- Prix : grille **EDF Tempo** de la puissance choisie en haut, en vigueur à chaque date (table `energy_offers`).
- Courbe de charge Enedis en **W moyens par demi-heure** (÷ 2 pour des Wh).

### Source

Données Enedis via l'add-on **MyElectricalData v2** (PostgreSQL, accès en lecture seule).

panels.title: Coût année de facturation
panels.description: Énergie au tarif Tempo en vigueur à chaque date + abonnement au prorata, depuis la date de début de facturation (variable en haut, format MM-JJ). Indépendant de la période affichée.

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    (c.date + c.interval_start::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS ts,
    ((c.date + c.interval_start::time) - interval '6 hours')::date AS tempo_date,
    (c.interval_start::time >= '22:00' OR c.interval_start::time < '06:00') AS is_hc,
    c.value / 2000.0 AS kwh
  FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'detailed' AND c.date >= (SELECT CASE WHEN s.d > current_date THEN (s.d - interval '1 year')::date ELSE s.d END FROM (SELECT to_date(extract(year FROM current_date)::int || '-$debut_facturation', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS d) s)
), p AS (
  SELECT x.tempo_date, x.kwh, t.color, o.subscription_price AS abo,
    CASE t.color
      WHEN 'BLUE'  THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_blue_hc  ELSE o.tempo_blue_hp  END
      WHEN 'WHITE' THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_white_hc ELSE o.tempo_white_hp END
      WHEN 'RED'   THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_red_hc   ELSE o.tempo_red_hp   END
    END AS prix
  FROM x
  LEFT JOIN tempo_days t ON t.id = to_char(x.tempo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT eo.* FROM energy_offers eo
    JOIN energy_providers ep ON ep.id = eo.provider_id
    WHERE eo.offer_type = 'TEMPO' AND eo.power_kva = $puissance_kva AND ep.name ILIKE '%EDF%'
    ORDER BY (eo.valid_from <= x.ts) DESC, abs(extract(epoch FROM eo.valid_from - x.ts))
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
)
SELECT
  SUM(kwh * prix) + count(*) / 48.0 * MAX(abo) * 12 / 365 AS "Coût"
FROM p

panels.title: Coût énergie journalier (jour Tempo 6h-6h)
panels.description: Coût de l'énergie seule (hors abonnement), calculé à la demi-heure : heures creuses 22h-6h, couleur du jour Tempo de 6h à 6h.

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    (c.date + c.interval_start::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS ts,
    ((c.date + c.interval_start::time) - interval '6 hours')::date AS tempo_date,
    (c.interval_start::time >= '22:00' OR c.interval_start::time < '06:00') AS is_hc,
    c.value / 2000.0 AS kwh
  FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'detailed' AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
), p AS (
  SELECT x.tempo_date, x.kwh, t.color, o.subscription_price AS abo,
    CASE t.color
      WHEN 'BLUE'  THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_blue_hc  ELSE o.tempo_blue_hp  END
      WHEN 'WHITE' THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_white_hc ELSE o.tempo_white_hp END
      WHEN 'RED'   THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_red_hc   ELSE o.tempo_red_hp   END
    END AS prix
  FROM x
  LEFT JOIN tempo_days t ON t.id = to_char(x.tempo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT eo.* FROM energy_offers eo
    JOIN energy_providers ep ON ep.id = eo.provider_id
    WHERE eo.offer_type = 'TEMPO' AND eo.power_kva = $puissance_kva AND ep.name ILIKE '%EDF%'
    ORDER BY (eo.valid_from <= x.ts) DESC, abs(extract(epoch FROM eo.valid_from - x.ts))
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
)
SELECT
  tempo_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS time,
  SUM(kwh * prix) FILTER (WHERE color = 'BLUE')  AS "Bleu",
  SUM(kwh * prix) FILTER (WHERE color = 'WHITE') AS "Blanc",
  SUM(kwh * prix) FILTER (WHERE color = 'RED')   AS "Rouge"
FROM p
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
